description: This file declares a template interface for an iterator type within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, defining methods for iteration operations such as Next, Previous, Reset, IsValid, Count, and Current.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for an iterator over elements of type ELEMENT, with methods for iteration control and state inspection.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputting it in 'info'.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputting it in 'info'.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the collection.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element at the iterator's position.
